title: Operator kit
description: Hand-written hit structure of an operator's skills: which blackboard values multiply into each hit and how often it lands. Numbers come from the game tables; only structure is written here. Each kit lists its sources.

variants.description: The same kit under other operator IDs (the Endministrator's two): strings starting with this kit's operator ID are renamed to the variant's, after the explicit `skills` renames; game-buff IDs (buff_…) stay.

skills.description: Skill IDs that don't follow the rename (chr_0003_endminf_power_attack2 → chr_0002_endminm_power_attack).

element.description: Default element of the operator's hits.

activeConditions.description: What the game's condition IDs on this operator's talent and potential effects (PotentialTalentEffectTable activeCondition) mean, as Predicates; cite where the meaning comes from in the kit's sources.

buffs.description: Timed buffs and debuffs the operator's hits apply (engine buffs.ts): on themselves, the team, or the enemy (acting on every team member's hits). Values come from the game data (valueSpec).

gameBuff.description: The BuffData buff this stands for; when it is priority-keyed (stackingType 1), instances from different operators don't add up (only the strongest counts).

loggedAs.description: Further BuffData buffs a battle log lists this buff's effects under, beside gameBuff and the affix buffs its file's Susceptibility and Amp actions create (which the log check finds itself): the game gives them in its place to some recipients (Liino's stance ATK is buff_chr_0035_liino_atkup_owner on Liino herself). The log check verifies the kit buff's modifiers against these entries instead of adding them; each must be a fetched BuffData file.

dataOverride.description: Its duration differs on purpose from what the data's CreateBuff of its game buff gives (where a skill's hit or own cast trigger applies it), with the reason (docs/design.md, "Kits and the game data").

duration.description: Seconds; 0: not applied (a buff a potential unlocks has 0 below it). Absent: until a trigger ends it or a cast consumes it.

modifiers.description: Empty for a state that only gates skills (availableWhile).

attr.description: An attribute instead of a zone (mapped to its zone like any stat; one that doesn't act on hits, e.g. Ultimate Gain Efficiency 44, is read where the game reads it).

percent.description: An attribute read where the game reads it (DEF, Strength, …) as a percentage: adds value × (base + Σ add) of the receiver's panel line, in the panel's percent slot (BuffData formulaItem 6; the loader takes it from the game buff).

if.description: Only while this holds at each hit, for the hitter (its target's state, e.g. enemyControl slow).

decorations.description: Only on landings with any of these decorations (BuffData CheckDamageDecorateMask: Final Strike 2097152, finisher 4, dive 1024): for a zone, an attribute feeding one, or Stagger efficiency (attribute 26, which the Stagger of such landings reads).

items.description: A zone or an attribute (exactly one; the loader checks).

priority.description: What the game buff's instances in one stack group are ranked by, where the game fills its priority key at creation from a value the loader can't read (a parent buff's): the highest acts whole. Usually the loader derives it (KitBuff.priority); tests/kits-priority.test.ts says which kits must state it.

maxStacks.description: Layered (BuffData stackingType 2 / 11): up to this many instances from one owner, each with its own duration; at the maximum a new one replaces the oldest. Modifiers add up per layer.

recipients.description: Team buffs only: the members it reaches, judged per member at application with the applier as owner (isOwner, sameElementAsOwner, operatorProfession, operatorElement).

consumedBy.description: The next cast of these kinds by someone it reaches consumes it; it then acts on that cast's hits only (Link, Jade Vessel's combo bonus).

consumedScope.description: What a consumed buff acts on: cast, the consuming cast's own hits (a damage modifier that checks the cast ID); whileCasting, also every other hit of the caster until the cast ends (a buff attached to the cast, CreateBuffAttachingSkill: status, reaction and trigger hits). Default: the loader reads it from the data where it can tell, else cast.

every.description: Periodic: a buffTick event every this many seconds while active, for triggers.

tickOnApply.description: The first tick comes when it's applied (default: one interval later).

endsWithCast.description: Ends with the action that applied it (CreateBuffAction autoFinishByAction): when its owner's current skill ends or the owner starts another; not applied outside a skill.

blocksEnergy.description: While active, its owner gains no ultimate energy (RefrainObtainUsp).

records.description: Enemy buffs only: records rate × the damage of every hit on its target while active (anyone's; reactions and ticks included, Fixed DMG not). buffEnded triggers read the total as {eventRecorded: true}.

sharedTimer.description: Layers share one timer each new layer refreshes (BuffData stackingType 8 or 10; the loader sets it from the game buff).

link.description: A team buff that counts as one Link stack while active; the next battle skill or ultimate that uses Link uses it and ends it.

categories.description: What it is for buffApplied category triggers and the operatorBuff predicate, in place of what its modifiers say (amp, susceptibility by zone; weakness, protection by attribute 62, 63): e.g. [] for a buff that only raises an active Amp's rate. The loader adds shield for a game buff with the shield tag (−1757502026).

basicAttack.description: While active, its owner's basic-attack input is this kit basic attack (a ComboCacheAction in the game buff's buffEvent 5; the loader sets it from gameBuff and checks a written one): it starts as a chain head or inside any window listing it, and the owner's other basic attacks (not finishers) can't start.

triggers.description: What the kit does when things happen in the fight (engine events.ts): combo windows (openCombo; quote the CharGrowthTable COMBO TRIGGER text in the note), team effects, talents. Without an openCombo trigger the timeline allows the combo whenever it's off cooldown.

finalStrike.description: Only Final Strikes (true) or only other hits (false); SkillData mask bit 2097152.

skills.description: Only hits of these skill IDs (any operator's).

decorations.description: Only landings with any of these decorations (SkillData decorate-mask bits 2097152, 4, 1024; a finisher is a skillSpecification 8 skill's, a dive a plunging attack's).

reaction.description: Only hits computed as a reaction or burst (true), or only others (false).

crit.description: Only hits that crit (true), or only others (false). With expected crits no hit counts as one: crit effects need rolled crits.

skills.description: Only casts of these skill IDs (a skill's own effects at frames, with delay).

finisher.description: Only finishers (true) or only other casts (false).

followUp.description: Only casts a skill made by itself (CastSkill, a trigger's cast action), or only the player's.

beside.description: Only casts that run beside the current action (KitSkill.beside: the beside path's effects at frame 0), or only those that replace it (the animated path's effects, at their frames).

fromKinds.description: Only events caused by hits of these kinds (CheckOriginSkillType); a trigger's own applications and status ticks are none.
Only events caused by hits of these kinds (CheckOriginSkillType); a trigger's own applications and status ticks are none.

reactions.description: Also when the infliction forms a reaction at once (it is applied all the same; abilityEvent 126 fires before the game resolves it). A reaction leaves no stacks, so it never meets minStacks above 1.

fromKinds.description: Only events caused by hits of these kinds (CheckOriginSkillType); a trigger's own applications and status ticks are none.
Only events caused by hits of these kinds (CheckOriginSkillType); a trigger's own applications and status ticks are none.

buff.description: One of the kit's own buffs.

toOthers.description: Only heals of someone other than the healer.

toOwner.description: Only heals of the trigger's owner, from any healer `by` allows (abilityEvent 45 OnReceiveHeal; the wielder's own heals are 50).

kinds.description: Only heals by these skill kinds (HealAction healTags); none for untagged heals (triggers).

fromKinds.description: Only events caused by hits of these kinds (CheckOriginSkillType); a trigger's own applications and status ticks are none.
Only events caused by hits of these kinds (CheckOriginSkillType); a trigger's own applications and status ticks are none.

fromNone.description: Only on an enemy that had no Vulnerable stacks before (true: Chimeric Justice's "an enemy with no Vulnerability stacks"), or only on one that had some (false).

rising.description: Only when the count went up (true: not a stack added at the cap of 4), or only when it didn't (false).

fromKinds.description: Only events caused by hits of these kinds (CheckOriginSkillType); a trigger's own applications and status ticks are none.
Only events caused by hits of these kinds (CheckOriginSkillType); a trigger's own applications and status ticks are none.
Only events caused by hits of these kinds (CheckOriginSkillType); a trigger's own applications and status ticks are none.

oneOf.description: The enemy attacks someone (the scenario's enemyActions); `by` is the one attacked (`controlled`: the controlled operator). `elements`: only attacks of these elements.
The enemy starts charging a skill (the scenario's enemyActions).
Someone (`by`) perfectly dodges an enemy attack (abilityEvent 145; the scenario's dodge option).

Someone (`by`: the one who gains it; `self` for "after the wielder gains Link") gains Link stacks (abilityEvent 9 with CheckBuffIdInContext buff_common_affixes_combo_trigger) from anyone's trigger action `link`. Link stacks are the team's: every member gains them. `eventCount`: the stacks.

categories.description: Any kit buff (own, weapon or gear set) of one of these categories, applied by whoever `by` names: Amp and Susceptibility by zone, Weakness and Protection by attribute 62, 63, Shield by its game buff's tag (KitBuff.categories overrides).

fromKinds.description: Only buffs applied by skills of these kinds (a hit's, or a trigger's run by its owner's own skill); none otherwise.

elements.description: Only when a listed category of the buff reaches one of these elements (an all-element or all-Arts one counts): tag 1066759270 Physical Susceptibility = [physical], 1427729990 Arts Susceptibility = the four Arts elements.

allElements.description: Only when a listed category of the buff reaches every one of these (tag 486772476 Arts Amp: only an all-Arts or all-element Amp).

toOthers.description: Only when the buff reaches an operator other than its applier (a team buff, a buff given to a teammate).

received.description: Only when the buff reaches the trigger's owner ("the wielder gains"; from anyone with by: anyone).

tags.description: The data's buff tags (CheckBuffIdInContext tag query: any of them); the loader turns them into categories and elements (packages/data/src/buffTags.ts), or refuses tags it can't.

oneOf.description: buffApplied by the game's buff tags, as the categories form.
The enemy's stagger bar passes one of its Stagger Nodes (EnemyData poiseKnotPctList).

kinds.description: Only SP from skills of these kinds (a hit's damage type; a trigger's owner skill).

natural.description: Only natural SP (true: ObtainCostAction atbGainMethod 0, which gives ultimate energy when spent), or only returned SP (false).

sourceTypes.description: Only grants of these atbSourceTypes (CheckObtainAtbType obtainTypeList: 1 basic attacks, 3 skills, 0 finishers and some extras), from the granting key's ObtainCostAction; a grant whose data doesn't say has none.

oneOf.description: Someone (by) recovers SP for the team by a hit or a trigger (not regeneration).

gameBuffs.description: Any kit buff standing for one of these BuffData buffs, applied by whoever `by` names.
Any kit buff standing for one of these BuffData buffs ends, owned by whoever `by` names.

consumed.description: Only ends by an action before it ran out (true: an endBuff, a cast consuming it), or only the others (false: expiry, the end of its cast).

oneOf.description: A kit buff standing for one of these BuffData buffs ends (Alesh's combo: Originium Crystals consumed); judged on the situation at the event.

by.description: Whose events count. Stack and own-buff events are always the owner's.

if.description: Judged for the owner when the event happens.

cooldown.description: Seconds before it can fire again.

cooldownPer.description: The cooldown counts per event subject (the healed operator of a heal, else the event's operator).

maxCount.description: At most this many times per fight.

maxPerCast.description: At most this many times per cast whose hits cause the events (events of no cast aren't limited).

chance.description: It fires with this chance (BuffData Probablity), judged for the owner after `if`, rolled on the battle's `chance` stream (the scenario's seed); a miss starts no cooldown and counts for nothing.

beforeDamage.description: Status events only: runs on a hit's own status events before that hit's damage, so a buff it applies acts on the hit.

delay.description: Frames after the event when the actions run (the trigger's if is judged at the event, each action's own if when it runs).

dataOverride.description: A cast trigger's actions compared with its skill's compiled SkillData (energy, sp, apply at the delay's frame): the ones that differ on purpose, each with the reason (docs/design.md, "Kits and the game data").

afterHits.description: With delay: at its frame the actions run after the hits landing then (default: before them). The game runs a skill's clips starting on one frame in file order: a clip listed after the damage clip it starts with takes this.

detached.description: A delayed cast trigger's actions happen even if the cast is cut short (by default they are the cast's own and are dropped with it).

launch.description: A detached cast trigger's launch (skill frames after the cast, at most `delay`): until then its actions are the cast's own (a cut or a jump over it drops them, a jump before it moves them); after it, they run whatever happens.

awaited.description: A delayed cast trigger whose actions are the skill's own effect: a rotation step without `at` waits for it, as for the cast's own hits.

skill.description: The skill (or talent / potential source) plain value keys name.

skills.description: A window of its own that only these combo skills of the kit use (and need): it isn't subject to the rule that the owner's own combo doesn't open its window (a combo opening its next sequence), and opens unless all of them are on cooldown.

seconds.description: How long the window stays open (default 6 s; without it and with whileBuff, as long as the buff).

whileBuff.description: The window is open only while this own kit buff is active (applied before or right after in the same trigger); extending the buff extends it, its end closes it (a finisher's PauseComboSkillTime: extendBuff).

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).
This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

amount.description: How many (default 1); {"consumed": true} for the infliction stacks the hit consumed.

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).
This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).
This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

percentOfMax.description: value is a fraction of the owner's maximum energy (isPercentValue).

ignoreEfficiency.description: Not scaled by Ultimate Gain Efficiency (ignoreUspGainScalar).

ignoreBlock.description: Given even while energy gain is blocked (useUspRecoverTag).

spKind.description: Natural SP gives ultimate energy when spent; returned SP is spent first and gives none. Default: what the trigger's skill's data says for a plain key (atbGainMethod), else returned.

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).
This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

to.description: A team buff for the event's subject only: the healed operator of a heal, else the operator who caused the event.

layers.description: This many layers at once (default 1; 0 applies none), e.g. one per Status Level consumed ({eventCount: true}).

duration.description: This application's seconds instead of the buff's (the CreateBuffAction's assigned duration): the same buff, so one layer cap across applications of different lengths.

untilFrame.description: It ends at this skill frame of the owner's current skill, or when that skill ends sooner (CreateBuffAction autoFinishByAction in a clip shorter than the cast); not applied while the owner isn't in a skill or past that frame.

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

layers.description: End only the oldest this many layers (default: all).

to.description: A team buff stops reaching the event's subject only (the healed operator of a heal, else the operator who caused the event); the others keep it, and it ends when it reaches no one.

seconds.description: Seconds added to the remaining cooldown (negative cuts it).

fraction.description: Instead of seconds: this fraction of the skill's full cooldown added to the remaining time (negative cuts it; SetSkillCdAtOnce isPercentage, assumed, in-game test 36).

set.description: Instead: start a cooldown of this many seconds, whether one is running or not (SetSkillCdAtOnce functionType 1).

setFraction.description: Instead: start a cooldown of this fraction of each skill's own full cooldown, whether one is running or not (SetSkillCdAtOnce functionType 1 with isPercentage).

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

oneOf.description: Exactly one of seconds, fraction, set and setFraction (the loader checks).

hits.description: Landed as the trigger's owner, at frames counted from the event; scale keys name the trigger's skill.

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

now.description: Its frame-0 hits land as the action runs, before the trigger's next action (a DamageAction inside the game's event handler).

seconds.description: Added to the remaining time of every active layer (a state a skill pauses).

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).
This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

healKind.description: The skill kind the heal's tag names (HealAction healTags); default none.

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

skill.description: One of the owner's kit skills, cast by itself (SkillData CastSkill): no control, cost or cooldown; it ends the owner's current skill.

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

trigger.description: One of this kit's triggers: the owner's hits from it still to land are dropped.

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).
This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

oneOf.description: End the owner's current skill now (JumpToAction to its end): its hits and delayed actions still to come are dropped, and the operator is free.

count.description: Link stacks given to the team (default 1).

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

oneOf.description: Give the team Link stacks (the data's ComboAction: Lifeng's and Camille's combos). A combo cast gives none by itself; the next battle skill or ultimate, by anyone, uses up to 4.

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

oneOf.description: An event-driven JumpToAction: if the owner's current skill is `skill` and its playhead (skill frames) is in [from, until), it moves to `to`; the frames between are skipped as for the data's own jumps.

weight.description: Judged when the action runs: the option's probability is weight / Σ weights; 0 excludes it.

do.description: Its actions, run in place of the choose (before the trigger's next action); none for an option that does nothing.

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

oneOf.description: A weighted random choice (Purrchena's giftbox item): one option's actions run, rolled on the battle's chance stream (one roll whatever the weights); all weights 0 runs none.

statusTweaks.description: How the statuses this operator applies differ from the standard ones (Arcane's talent: Corrosion lasts longer, shreds more).

capScale.description: Multiplier on the strength cap (Corrosion's shred cap).

skill.description: Where plain value keys come from (an own skill or a talent / potential source).

stacks.description: The operator's own counters (e.g. Laevatain's Melting Flame) that hits gain and require.

initial.description: At the start of a fight (default 0); name sources explicitly ({key, skill}), e.g. a talent's attached buff. A scenario's startStacks overrides it.

available.description: Castable only when this holds for the operator at the start frame (a state: buffActive; a stance: not buffActive; …).

energyBlockSeconds.description: The operator gains no ultimate energy for this long after the cast (SkillData RefrainObtainUsp buff duration).

jumps.description: When the skill's conditional jumps (SkillData JumpToAction with a condition, on its own timeline; by frame) are taken: `if`, judged for the caster at the cast. A conditional jump not listed isn't taken; unconditional ones always are (the frames between are skipped).

to.description: The jump's destination, when several conditional jumps leave the same frame (an IfElse's branches).

teamEnergy.description: The team's energy for the SP it spends, in parts (SkillData CreateBuff buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp, each with its ratio): frames from the cast. A part the cast is cut short before, or whose `if` (for the caster) doesn't hold at its frame, gives nothing. All at the cast when absent.

detached.description: It comes from something the skill left behind (an ability entity): not dropped when the cast is cut short or jumps.

takesControl.description: The caster becomes the controlled operator at the cast (ultimates: 'becomes the controlled operator').

cooldownGroup.description: Skills sharing a group share one cooldown: casting one puts every member on its own cooldown (Typhoeus's two combos).

chainStep.description: Override: a basic-attack chain step, castable only while the chain points at it (default from the data: an earlier step's cancel window lists it).

windows.description: When the skill's conditional windows (SkillData AllowNextSkillAction under a TogglableAction or an IfElse branch; by frame, and skills to tell apart two at one frame; all at that frame without skills) are open: when `if` holds for the caster at the cast, always without one. A conditional window not listed stays closed.

comboWindow.description: A combo-kind skill cast without the combo window (from another button), with its own cost and cooldown, gated by `available`; a combo for everything else (cast and hits of kind combo, no Link). It doesn't use up the combo window.

dataOverride.description: Where this skill differs from the compiled SkillData on purpose, each with the reason: `teamEnergy`, `energyBlockSeconds`, `applies@<frame>` (what its hits apply at that frame), `lands <file>` (landings in that file no hit of the kit stands for). The loader neither fills these in nor refuses the difference.

noDodge.description: Skill frames [from, until) on the cast's playhead in which the controlled operator doesn't dash at an enemy attack, with dodging on (a counter that isn't a jump: a guard that wants to be hit); the attack lands and its triggers fire.

beside.description: When this holds at the cast, the skill runs beside the operator's current action instead of ending it (SkillData switchToBuffConfig, asSkillCast): the current skill keeps its hits, lock and chain.

followUpOnly.description: Only a skill's own cast action (CastSkill, a trigger's cast) starts it; rotations can't.

buffCategory.description: What a buff is (engine events.ts BuffCategory): Amp and Susceptibility by zone, Weakness and Protection by attribute 62 / 63, Shield by its game buff's tag −1757502026.

anyOf.description: The element the enemy already has (none: nothing happens).
The element of the event behind it (a combo's: the infliction that opened its window); none: nothing happens.

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

afterDamage.description: A hit's application only: it (and its if) runs after the hit's damage, for data where a FinishBuffByTag or consumption follows the DamageAction. Default: before the damage, which sees it.

level.description: Status level 1–4 (default 1), judged when it happens, after the hit's earlier applications: {consumed: true} is the stacks the preceding consumeInfliction took (ForceSpellStatusAction consumedLayer); 0 applies nothing.

durationKey.description: Skill blackboard value giving the status duration in seconds, when the skill sets it.

scaleKey.description: Skill blackboard value multiplying the status's strength (extra_scaling): Combustion's damage over time, Electrification's Arts DMG Taken, Corrosion's shred.

extraSeconds.description: Seconds added to this application's duration only (the common buffs' extra_duration), unlike statusTweaks.

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

afterDamage.description: A hit's application only: it (and its if) runs after the hit's damage, for data where a FinishBuffByTag or consumption follows the DamageAction. Default: before the damage, which sees it.

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

afterDamage.description: A hit's application only: it (and its if) runs after the hit's damage, for data where a FinishBuffByTag or consumption follows the DamageAction. Default: before the damage, which sees it.

stacks.description: At most this many (the rest stays, with its timer); all when absent.

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

afterDamage.description: A hit's application only: it (and its if) runs after the hit's damage, for data where a FinishBuffByTag or consumption follows the DamageAction. Default: before the damage, which sees it.

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

afterDamage.description: A hit's application only: it (and its if) runs after the hit's damage, for data where a FinishBuffByTag or consumption follows the DamageAction. Default: before the damage, which sees it.

anyOf.description: The physical status of the event behind it (a combo's: the one that opened its window); none: nothing happens.

forced.description: A Lift / Knock Down that lands without Vulnerable (forceAirborne / forceKnockDown).

multiplierKey.description: Skill value multiplying the status's hit (CrushAction damageMultiplier).

scaleKey.description: Breach only: skill value multiplying its Physical DMG Taken, not its hit (buff_physical_do_fracture: physical_res_down × extra_scaling).

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

afterDamage.description: A hit's application only: it (and its if) runs after the hit's damage, for data where a FinishBuffByTag or consumption follows the DamageAction. Default: before the damage, which sees it.

status.description: The control status (the game's tag), e.g. immobilization.

durationKey.description: Skill value giving its duration in seconds.

freezes.description: It stops the enemy's own clock meanwhile (an entity time dilation of scale 0).

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

afterDamage.description: A hit's application only: it (and its if) runs after the hit's damage, for data where a FinishBuffByTag or consumption follows the DamageAction. Default: before the damage, which sees it.

predicate.description: When something happens (engine expr.ts Predicate). Judged with what's known at that moment; the log checker tries both outcomes of what a log can't tell.

oneOf.description: Panel attribute [0] ≥ [1] (attribute IDs; Arcane: Intellect 41 ≥ Will 42 is INT mode).

talentAtLeast.description: [talent index (0-based, as in a build's talents), level]: the talent is learned to at least this level.

buffLayers.description: One of the kit's own buffs: its active layers (a plain buff's: 1 or 0) are at least atLeast and below below. Each threshold is a whole number or a value (a data key such as free_sword_limit), judged for the predicate's skill.

controlled.description: The operator is the controlled one (for a hit: when its skill was cast).

enemyModifier.description: The enemy has a buff from anyone with a modifier in this zone that reaches this element (an all-element one counts).

operatorElement.description: The operator's element is one of these.

operatorProfession.description: The operator's profession (CharacterTable profession number) is one of these.

isOwner.description: The operator is the effect's owner (false for a teammate a team buff reaches).

sameElementAsOwner.description: The operator has the effect owner's element.

eventOperator.description: Judged for the operator who caused the event a trigger reacts to.

enemyPhysical.description: The enemy has this physical status.

enemyVulnerable.description: The enemy has at least this many Vulnerable stacks.

enemyHpBelow.description: The enemy's HP is below this fraction of its Max HP (a value: a literal or the data's key, e.g. CheckHp's hp_remain; the scenario sets the enemy's HP over the fight; full by default).

enemyControl.description: The enemy has this control status.

enemyBuff.description: A buff from anyone that stands for this BuffData buff (its gameBuff) is on the enemy.

operatorModifier.description: A buff from anyone that reaches the operator has a modifier in this zone (an Amped teammate).

operatorBuff.description: A buff from anyone that reaches the operator is of one of these categories (shield: a game buff with tag −1757502026), or stands for this BuffData buff (the twin of enemyBuff).

castLink.description: The hit's own cast used at least atLeast (default 1) Link stacks; false for a triggered hit of no cast.

currentAction.description: The operator's running action is a skill of these kinds, before its exclusive frame with beforeExclusive (CheckSkillType checkTargetCurSkill, mustBeforeExclusiveTime): for a skill's beside.

enemySuperArmor.description: The enemy's super armor is at least / below this (CheckSuperArmor; EnemyAttributeTemplateTable initialSuperArmor, zeroPoiseSuperArmor while Staggered).

enemyRank.description: The enemy's rank is one of these: EnemyTemplateDisplayInfoTable displayType (0 Common, 1 Elite, 2 Boss, 3 Advanced, 4 Alpha in 555me's DisplayEnemyTypeTable). CheckEnemyRank's enemyRankSet reads as a bit set over them (a claim): 1 Common, 2 Elite.

valueExpr.description: A number from the game data (engine expr.ts ValueExpr): a literal; a string = a skill value of the skill in context (at the build's level, after potentials); or a combination.

buffLayers.description: The active layers of one of the kit's own buffs (a plain buff's: 1 or 0).

eventRemaining.description: Seconds the ended buff of a buffEnded event had left (0 when it ran out).

eventRecorded.description: The damage the recording buff of a buffEnded event recorded (KitBuff records).

key.description: A value of the buff or skill the talent attaches at the build's level of it (0 while not learned).

enemyInflictionStacks.description: The enemy's infliction stacks of this element (0 when it has none, or another element's): the twin of enemyVulnerableStacks.

div.description: The first divided by the second.

scale.description: Empty for a Fixed DMG hit, or when scaleValue alone gives the multiplier.

count.description: How many times the hit lands per use: a whole number ≥ 1, or a value judged at the cast for the caster (before a requires uses stacks up; a triggered hit's when its action runs), e.g. {"buffLayers": …}; a value of 0 lands nothing. Each landing is its own hit.

events.description: Event keys battle logs (ZMDLogs) use for this hit. Default: the skill ID, when the skill has a single hit entry.

frames.description: Frame (30 FPS, from the skill's start) at which each landing happens; one entry per count (a count that's a value: the first landings', the rest repeat the last, framesEvery apart). Projectile travel time isn't in the data, so projectile hits use the launch frame.

framesEvery.description: A count that's a value: frames between the landings past `frames` (default: all at its last frame).

bonuses.description: The hit's own zone bonuses from its skill's values (after potentials), e.g. a projectile's damage bonus on its first target.

zoneScale.description: For this hit only, every modifier of the zone that reaches it (anyone's, the enemy's debuffs and statuses included; only those reaching the hit's element) × value, judged as it lands: a damage unit's target-side InstantModifyAttribute with formulaItem 8 on the zone's attribute (Last Rite's ultimate: Cryo Susceptibility × rate).

atkSnapshot.description: A buffTick trigger's hit only (DamageAction takeAtkSnapshot): it takes its owner's attacker-side modifiers (ATK, DMG bonus, Amp, crit, Arts Intensity) from when the ticking buff was applied; the enemy's side is read at the tick.

factor.description: Literal multiplier from the skill graph (a SimpleCalcBB × or ÷ splitting a value, e.g. 0.5 for one of two arrows); cite it in the note.

reaction.description: The hit's damage is an arts burst or reaction (no skill-type bonus; level coefficient and Arts Intensity apply), times its scale keys, e.g. Typhoeus's own Nature burst.

energy.description: Ultimate energy the operator gains when the hit lands (SkillData ObtainCostAction costType 0, e.g. a combo's usp).

buffs.description: Kit buffs this hit applies when it lands; beforeDamage: the buff already acts on this hit.

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

duration.description: This application's seconds instead of the buff's (the CreateBuffAction's assigned duration): the same buff, one layer cap.

untilFrame.description: It ends at this skill frame of the operator's current skill, or when that skill ends sooner (CreateBuffAction autoFinishByAction in a clip shorter than the cast).

finalStrike.description: Override: whether the hit is a Final Strike. By default read from SkillData (decorate-mask bit 2097152) via the hit's events.

dive.description: Override: whether the hit is a dive attack's landing. By default read from SkillData (decorate-mask bit 1024) as finalStrike is.

requires.description: The hit only happens if the operator's stack is in range (atLeast, below) when the skill is cast, judged before the cast uses anything up. consume: all of the stack (true) or that many (a value), once per cast and stack (the largest amount named); consumeAt: at the cast (default) or when this hit lands.

gains.description: Stacks gained when the hit lands: a fixed amount (default 1) or the infliction stacks the hit consumed.

amount.description: How many (default 1); {"consumed": true} for the infliction stacks the hit consumed.

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

applies.description: What each landing does to the enemy's arts state, in order (packages/engine/src/status.ts). Skill descriptions say which hits inflict; the game data doesn't.

if.description: The hit happens only in this situation, judged as it lands, before its own effects (a mode, an enemy status…).

scaleValue.description: A multiplier computed from values (e.g. a sum of two value keys), times `scale`.

extraScale.description: Extra multipliers that apply only in a situation.

damageType.description: Which skill-type DMG bonus applies; none for no skill type. Required on triggered hits. On a skill's hit, an override of the skill's (a hit whose decorate mask lacks its skill's kind, e.g. one treated as another type): the hit takes that type's bonus and its hit event that kind, while the cast stays the skill's (SP, cast events, team energy).

dataOverride.description: Fields in which this hit differs from the compiled SkillData on purpose (a value the kit writes that isn't the data's, or one it leaves out that the data has), each with the reason: the loader neither fills these in from the data nor refuses the difference (docs/design.md, "Kits and the game data").

poiseOnly.description: A landing that deals only its poise (SkillData DamageAction whose units are all damageAttributeType 1): Stagger, nodes and staggered events, no damage, crit or hit event. Needs poise and an empty scale; no damage, effects or resources of its own.

heals.description: Whom the hit heals: an event for heal triggers (amounts aren't modelled).

sp.description: SP when the hit lands (ObtainCostAction costType 1 at this hit); the skill's atb is then not added to its first hit.

spKind.description: The SP's kind; default: what the skill's data says for a plain key (atbGainMethod 0 natural, 1 returned), else returned.

spBeforeDamage.description: The hit's sp comes before its damage (ObtainCostAction before the DamageAction in the same tick): triggers on that SP act before the damage, so a buff they apply counts for this hit. Default: after the damage.

detached.description: Lands even if the skill is interrupted before it (a projectile or ability entity already on its way); other hits still to land are cancelled when the operator starts another skill.

enemyDelay.description: Its damage comes this many frames after the landing, on the enemy's clock (time stops hold it): a buff the landing puts on the enemy deals it after its triggerInterval (Typhoeus's Power Shot burst). The landing's applications, gains, buffs, SP and energy happen at its frame; the damage reads what they consumed.

launch.description: A detached hit's launch frame (its LaunchProjectile or SpawnAbilityEntity): until then the cast's own (a cut cast or a jump over it drops it; a jump before it moves it); after it, it lands whatever happens. Implies detached.

poise.description: Stagger damage (SkillData damage units of damageAttributeType 1, e.g. the skill's poise key).

poiseControlledOnly.description: Its stagger counts only while its operator is controlled (onlyEnableForMainChar: Final Strikes).

branch.description: Alternatives of one landing (an IfElse): hits sharing a branch are judged together on the situation before any of them lands; the first in kit order whose if holds lands.

fixedDamage.description: Fixed DMG (SkillData damageType 8): the hit deals exactly this value, no ATK, zones, crit, DEF, RES or Staggered multiplier; scale is []. A triggered hit's value is judged when its trigger fires (e.g. {eventRecorded: true}).

base.description: What the multiplier multiplies instead of ATK (MultiplyAttributeCalculation: e.g. 300 + 5 × DEF); every other zone as usual.
